# chatgpt-mara (fictional)

A tiny ChatGPT export for Mara Keller, made up and shaped like the real thing: two conversation shards, both asset-name maps,
a manifest, and account files (`user.json`, `user_settings.json`, `chat.html`) that the tools must never open.

It contains a branched conversation (an edited-away message), hidden context, a pasted block over 2,000 chars, attachments
(one per map plus one unknown), two conversations with the same date and title, one with a single user turn, one that is
almost all pasted, and a few correction replies in German and English. `tests/test_chatgpt_import.py` checks all of them.
